notes: Thumb navigation test build: includes Summary and Undo/Redo that survive closing the app. Start on Home: existing project cards and View last summary should open Edit.
In Edit, try Close, Undo, Redo and icon Export in the single bottom toolbar. Swipe the middle tools to reveal more, and check reach while holding the phone in either hand.
Try a spare project: copy a clip with Edit + → Other Pulse, then Undo. Close and fully relaunch Pulse, reopen the project and tap Redo. The clip should return, even if the project was empty.
Home + → Blank project opens the camera. Record and stop a short clip, expand the lower camera tools, then Export. Check these controls with one hand.
Home + → Summary → Choose projects → Create summary opens copied beats in the recorder. View last summary opens Edit; Close returns to the same Summary form.
If a destination requires a name during Export, open the keyboard and try the lower Close button. Also try larger text; the return control should remain available.
Known limits: some library, calendar and sheet controls remain high; overflowing editor tools still need a swipe. Caption keyboard, RTL and Android checks remain outstanding.
Known Split issue: tapping Split again without moving the playhead can create a very short extra clip. Undo rejoins it. Real camera and screen-recording behavior still need your phone test.
